recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17201 unless a future work group decision reopens whether participant type should distinguish systems from devices.
issue_request: FHIR-17201 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request raised against STU3 PlanDefinition. It asked that PlanDefinition.action.participant.type support a system/device participant, and the accepted resolution was to add device to the action participant type value set.
initial_application: The historical SVN-to-git application is visible in commit 3dc81b908557be64248363dc4e5bbf5ed5213965, git-svn build r14073, which explicitly cites GF#17201 and adds participant type/device support to PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition. Commit 218ca52323d4eeaca9d06b840cf6b24edd19891b, git-svn build r14074, follows up by fixing participant type short descriptions for GF#17201.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source no longer uses the old spreadsheet representation, but the action-participant-type CodeSystem and ValueSet source are present under the PlanDefinition resource folder, and the live CI build publishes the same device code. Later DeviceDefinition/typeReference Jira issues are related participant-reference refinements, not changes to the FHIR-17201 value set decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current action-participant-type CodeSystem defines device as a system or device used in patient care; the ValueSet includes that CodeSystem; and PlanDefinition.action.participant.type and PlanDefinition.actor.option.type have required bindings to that ValueSet and list device in their short code lists.

related_jiras.note: Published CDS issue about allowing DeviceDefinition in PlanDefinition.action.participant.typeReference; separate from the seed's participant type code/value set decision.
Submitted R6 request about DeviceDefinition references in PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition; not final and not part of this seed decision.
